subject: Riverview security discovery: SSO/SCIM & IAM evidence — next steps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Simmons <laura.simmons@riverviewhealth.org>, security@riverviewhealth.org
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 30 Jun 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Riverview security discovery: SSO/SCIM & IAM evidence — next steps

Hi Laura — thanks again for taking the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned with your security team: 

Summary from our call:
- Scope: pilot integration for user provisioning and SSO for 2 internal apps (clinical portal + analytics).
- Must-haves called out by your team: HIPAA BAA, ability to deploy in us-east region, SSO via SAML/OIDC, SCIM for provisioning, RBAC for admin vs. non-admin users, audit logs for user activity.

What we can provide immediately:
- SOC 2 status: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type I report on file and we are in progress for Type II (expected completion Q4 2028). We can provide the current control matrix and a bridge letter.
- GDPR/HIPAA: We support data residency in US regions and can sign a BAA — will include standard terms and options for customizations.
- IAM evidence: we can share SAML metadata (IdP/SP), our SCIM schema and example payloads, RBAC role mapping docs, and an audit log sample (redacted).

Action items (proposed timelines):
1) I’ll attach our vendor security questionnaire (V1) and a short SSO/SCIM checklist — please have your security ops team flag any gaps by Wed Jul 4.
2) Laura / security@riverview: share the required SAML metadata file(s) (entityID, ACS URL, x509 cert) and the SCIM attributes you expect for provisioning.
3) Neha and I will prepare a short technical handoff (30–45m) with our engineers to walk through SAML binding, SCIM endpoints, and RBAC mappings. Proposed window: week of Jul 8.

Attachments: [Attachment: vendor_security_questionnaire_v1.pdf (application/pdf)], [Attachment: redwood_sso_scim_checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

If that timeline looks good, we’ll schedule the handoff and track items in HubSpot/Drive.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0182
https://redwoodinference.com
From: Laura Simmons <laura.simmons@riverviewhealth.org>

Cc: security@riverviewhealth.org
Date: Sat, 30 Jun 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Riverview security discovery: SSO/SCIM & IAM evidence — next steps

Hi Ben — thanks for the summary, very helpful. A few notes from our side: 

- SOC 2: we reviewed your note; our security ops requires the latest SOC 2 Type I report + control matrix and any in-progress evidence for Type II. A bridge letter would be great.
- HIPAA/BAA: we will need a copy of Redwood’s standard BAA to start procurement and legal review.
- SSO & provisioning: we use Okta as our IdP. I can share the SAML metadata (our org entityID and ACS) and the SCIM attributes we usually expect (email, givenName, familyName, employeeNumber, groups).

I’ve looped our security mailbox so they can triage the questionnaire you attached. Security will likely ask for:
- Admin role definitions and separation of duties (who can promote users to admin)
- RBAC matrix and how role changes are audited
- Sample audit log extract showing user provisioning events (timestamp, actor, action)

We’ll aim to get the SAML metadata and a prioritized list of missing items to you by Tue Jul 3; if anything is urgent for the pilot, call it out in the questionnaire and we’ll expedite.

Best,
Laura Simmons
Sr. PM, Access & Identity | Riverview Health
laura.simmons@riverviewhealth.org

Laura — perfect, thank you. Two quick clarifications and one ask: 

Clarifications:
- Our SOC 2 Type I report and control matrix are attached here; the bridge letter is being prepared and I’ll share once finalized.
- For BAA: I’ve attached our standard BAA template. If legal needs a redline, we can open that loop.

Ask for security ops (so we can scope engineering work):
1) Please share the SAML metadata file (XML) and the preferred ACS URL for the pilot apps.
2) Confirm whether provisioning should be one-way (Okta -> Redwood) or two-way. We support inbound SCIM provisioning from Okta and can push status updates back to a user profile attribute if needed.
3) For RBAC: send a sample of the roles you expect (e.g., clinician, supervisor, read-only analyst). If you have an existing role-to-groups mapping, that will speed the mapping.

I’ve uploaded the files to the Drive link in the original message and added the HubSpot deal with checklist tasks. If helpful, Neha can set up the technical handoff for Jul 9–10; she’s included here.

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood_SOC2_TypeI_control_matrix.pdf (application/pdf)], [Attachment: redwood_standard_BAA_v1.0.pdf (application/pdf)]

Thanks —
Ben
